rows.title: Financial Accounting
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcome
outcomes: Students are able to apply critical thinking skills derived from knowledge of accounting theory, to financial analysis and management decision making by analyzing and evaluating financial ratios and measurements.
Students are able to demonstrate an understanding of basic accounting principles and procedures, as well as the role of accounting and bookkeeping within various business organizations.
Students are able to recognize and understand the importance of ethics and social responsibility in the accounting profession.

Upon successful completion of this course, the students will be able to apply transaction analysis, input transactions into the accounting system, process this input, and prepare and interpret the four basic financial statements.
